These differences, while small, could affect email draft generation quality, particularly the active hours (1.5 hour difference) and response time expectations (2x difference). Minor issues: (1) Pierre's title differs ('Tech Lead' vs 'Lead Developer'), (2) Amelie's tone is 'semi-formal' vs 'formal', (3) Sarah's tone is 'casual' vs 'semi-formal', (4) interaction counts are higher (likely system counted differently), (5) added 'PartnerTech Integration' as separate project when ground truth merged it into GlobalTech partnership context, (6) terminology section added extra terms (CSP, POC) and omitted some ground truth terms (Sprint, Daily, Retro, PR), (7) added 'frequent_topics' section not in ground truth.
